description: Source code implementing PKCS#5 PBE2 encryption and decryption functions for OpenSSL, including ASN.1 encoding/decoding, cipher initialization, and handling of cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: add_cipher_oid
methods.description: Adds ASN.1 object identifier for a cipher based on its NID.

methods.name: pkcs5_pbe2_cipher_init
methods.description: Initializes cipher context for PBE2 encryption/decryption with given parameters.

methods.name: PKCS5_pbe2_encrypt_init
methods.description: Sets up ASN.1 structure for PBE2 encryption parameters and initializes cipher context.

methods.name: PKCS5_pbe2_decrypt_init
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 structure for PBE2 parameters and initializes cipher context for decryption.
